title: Hybrid Topological Data Analysis and LSTM Networks for Enhanced Network Intrusion Detection Using CIC-IDS2017 Dataset
summary: Network intrusion detection systems (NIDS) are crucial in cybersecurity infrastructure, needing advanced techniques to detect hostile activity in network traffic. This research introduces a hybrid approach that combines Topological Data Analysis (TDA) with Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks to improve anomaly detection in network security. Our multi-layered design combines TDA's persistent homology with LSTM networks to capture topological characteristics of network traffic patterns and simulate temporal sequences.
